artworks.title: Two Breton Women; Landscape [recto]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image includes two sketches on a single page. The left sketch shows two women in crayon, facing each other closely. Both women have indistinct facial features and wear head coverings. One woman holds a large object. The right sketch features a profile of a person with detailed hair and a prominent nose. Both sketches have plain backgrounds.

artworks.title: Two Cows; A Seated Breton Woman [verso]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract sketches. The drawing consists of two panels with minimalist sketches in black on a light-colored background. The left panel features rough sketches, including one that resembles a four-legged animal. Above the sketches, there is cursive writing in a darker tone. The right panel includes more abstract lines and shapes resembling parts of a human figure or an abstract structure, focusing on light and shadow. The drawings convey quick, expressive strokes and appear to be explorations of form and composition.

artworks.title: Five Sheep; Head of a Woman and Head of a Bearded Man [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a double-page sketch with two different sets of drawings, separated by a vertical line in the middle. On the right page, two partial sketches of human faces are visible. One shows a person facing slightly to the left with the forehead, eyes, nose, and lips visible. This figure has short, dark hair. Below it, another sketch shows a man's head in three-quarter view with a full beard, mustache, and short hair. Both sketches focus on facial features with loose strokes for hair and expressions. The left page has a series of sketchy, upside-down drawings that appear to be partial figures of animals, possibly cats, sketched with minimal detail. There is handwriting below the sketches, but it is not legible. The background is plain, with no color or context, emphasizing the sketches.

artworks.title: Man Playing Piano; Two Sheep [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: Two panels of simple line drawings. The left panel shows a figure in action with minimal lines and shading. The right panel includes sketches of two animals, possibly a sheep and a more abstract form. Each drawing is done in a raw sketch style with few lines.

artworks.title: A Head of Man with Hat, Seen from Behind; A Standing Woman [recto]
artworks.medium: crayon, graphite, and pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image consists of two panels on a plain background. The left panel shows the back view of a person wearing a hat with a wide brim. The right panel depicts a person in profile from the waist up, facing right, with minimal facial features and clothing details. Above the person are scattered written words.

artworks.title: Crouching Monkey and Man's Head; Bones and Muscles [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image contains two sections with abstract line drawings on a beige background. On the left, there is a figure composed of curved lines that resemble a crouching person, with additional rough sketches near it. The phrase "c'est un cul de jatte" is written below the central figure. On the right, the drawing features vertical and slightly curved lines intersected by round and oval shapes, resembling elongated figures or tall objects. These compositions suggest movement and abstract representation of human and natural forms through simple linework.

artworks.title: Studies of Jugs and Vases; A Man with Moustache and a Boy with a Hat [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite and crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of sketches on a single sheet. The left side contains sketches of objects like vases or urns in different perspectives. The right side includes sketches of profiles and an object resembling a hat. Lines vary in boldness, focusing on form and texture. The page seems to be a study or practice page showing various elements in a casual and experimental way.

artworks.title: Four Studies of Breton Women; Shapes and Vases [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various studies and sketches. On the left, there is a collection of sketches of human profiles and partial clothing, including hats or bonnets. At the top is a study of arm and garment textures, focusing on folds and fabric draping. On the right, there are abstract shapes, simplified forms, and graphic doodles, some with handwritten notations in a foreign language. The drawings have a rough, exploratory quality.

artworks.title: Five Studies of Soldiers and a Woman's Face; Two Figures [recto]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts sketchy outlines and partial views of figures spread across two panels. In the left panel, there are incomplete sketches of several individuals from varying angles, featuring only parts of their bodies. One figure is seen from the back, wearing a hat, while another's profile with a beard is apparent. The face of one individual shows some facial features, with prominent eyebrows and eyes partially visible, along with vague outlines of facial profiles with headgear. In the right panel, one figure is drawn in a simplified silhouette, suggesting a profile of a person in an overcoat. Another figure is roughly sketched with a noticeable cap, and the rest of the lines are sparse, depicting human forms in minimal detail without distinct facial features. The artwork lacks detailed information on clothing textures or colors. The background is a plain paper texture with no significant details or elements besides the sketched lines.

artworks.title: Soldiers; Four Soldiers and a Seated Figure [verso]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two sketches on a single piece of paper. On the left side, there is an abstract sketch featuring a partial face with hair, eyes, nose, and lips. The right side contains multiple small studies of a man in various poses, focusing on facial expressions and headgear. The central figure wears a broad-brimmed hat and is shown in profile. Above him are two smaller sketches of faces, one with eyes covered by a hat. Below the central figure, there are sketches of a man sitting and another profile with distinctive sideburns, both wearing hats. The background is plain, highlighting the line-focused nature of the sketches.

artworks.title: Church Tower; A Sketch of a Fan [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description:
The image shows two sketches on separate panels. 

On the left panel, there is a sketch of a tall, slender structure resembling a church steeple or tower. The spire extends upwards, slightly off-center to the left. A small, ambiguous shape is near the lower third of the panel to the right.

The right panel features abstract, faint lines indicating a figure in the upper part and a semicircular form with a vague human shape inside in the lower part. The sketches are minimalistic, rendered with light, precise strokes. The overall color palette is monochromatic, with the natural tone of the paper dominant.

artworks.title: Boy's Face; Two Sheep [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: Two sketches are displayed on a beige background. On the left is a simple sketch of a person's head and shoulders facing forward. The face includes basic features such as eyes, a nose, and a mouth with open lips. The hair is represented by curved lines, and one ear is larger. The right side shows faint outlines resembling a vague figure or abstract form without distinct facial features. The background of the image is plain.

artworks.title: A Profile and Four Shapes; Sketch of a Man's Head [recto]
artworks.medium: crayon, graphite, and pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract arrangement of shapes and lines. There are angular forms, freehand sketches, jagged lines resembling a human profile, triangles resembling folded paper or a mountain range, parallel lines with scattered numbers resembling a list or data chart, and vertical lines resembling a stylized human figure or furniture. The composition invites connections to everyday objects like faces, hills, or lists.

artworks.title: Scribbles; Two Shapes [verso]
artworks.medium: crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is divided into two panels. The left panel features abstract lines and curves. The right panel displays bold, irregular shapes connected by thin lines.

artworks.title: The Magrot House, Cuesmes
artworks.medium: graphite(?) over charcoal on wove paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows a house from the side, the front of the house facing the bottom right corner and one side of the house visible on the left. The house has several chimneys extending upward from its pointed, tiled roof. Four windows with shutters are visible on the front of the house, with a door on the left. Trees are sketched to the left of the house, and the sky behind it is blank. The background on the right is blank except for faint horizontal lines, perhaps indicating water or grass. The ground is shaded with short horizontal lines that suggest flat ground with some texture, like stone, dirt, or grass. The drawing has been done on off-white paper.

artworks.title: The Zandmennik House
artworks.medium: graphite(?) on wove paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a row of two or three white cottages or buildings. The pointed rooftops are uneven and covered with dark chimneys. The buildings each have several doors and windows. They are oriented diagonally, and the doors face the bottom left corner of the drawing. There are some small dark bushes on the far right, but otherwise the ground is mostly empty except for a few shadows. The sky is also mostly empty. The color palette is monochromatic gray, and the drawing has been made with soft lines.

artworks.title: Old Man Carrying a Basket, Facing Right
artworks.medium: graphite with gray and black wash on brown wove paper, squared lightly in graphite
artworks.description: This drawing shows the profile of an elderly man's full body as he stands, facing the right and slightly bent forward. His head is turned slightly downward, likely gazing at the basket he holds with both hands. His facial features include a prominent nose and thin lips, and he has a beard. His hair appears to be short and is mostly covered by a large top hat. The man is wearing a dark vest over a light-colored shirt and loose trousers. The background is plain, brown paper.

artworks.title: Man Polishing a Boot
artworks.medium: graphite and gray and black wash, heightened with white watercolor on wove paper, squared lightly with graphite

artworks.title: Study after "The Models"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing nude. The person's body is slightly angled and tilted to the side, with hands held together in front of the torso. They have short hair styled away from the face and delicately rendered facial features, with a subtle expression. There is no clothing, jewelry, or objects. The background consists of lightly detailed sketch lines portraying an interior space with geometric shapes. The name "Seurat" is inscribed at the bottom left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Margot Leaning against Reine's Knee
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch featuring the upper bodies of two people, a woman and a child. The woman is seated, slightly turned towards the left, with her head slightly bowed, as she appears to be focused on the child beside her. Her facial features are softly drawn, with closed eyes, and her hair is styled in an updo. She is wearing a long-sleeved garment, and her hands are gently resting near the child’s shoulder. The child is in a relaxed position, leaning affectionately against the woman. The child has medium-length hair with bangs and is looking forward with eyes open. They are wearing a garment with a modest collar. The sketch is simplistic and focuses on the interaction and proximity of the two figures, capturing an intimate moment. The background is plain with minimal detailing, placing emphasis on the figures themselves. A few light sketched lines are present, and there are small markings, including illegible writing, near the top of the image, as well as the initials "m.e" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Smiling Margot Wearing a Ruffled Bonnet
artworks.medium: graphite over red chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a young child seated on a comfortable chair. The child is facing forward with a relaxed sitting pose, soft facial features, a slight smile, and partially visible hair framed by a large bonnet. They are wearing a simple garment, and there is a decorative bow around the neck. The background is a blank page with visible creases and smudges, and the number "131" is written in blue above the child's head. The sketch is rendered with delicate pencil strokes.

artworks.title: A Landscape with Farm Buildings among Trees
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the composition, featuring trees and a structure. The artwork uses loose brushstrokes with ink or a similar medium, creating a sketch-like quality with minimal detail. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of brown on tan paper, giving it an earthy and subdued visual impact. Sketchy lines suggest a small path or stream leading towards the trees and structure in the distance.

artworks.title: Noah Leading the Animals into the Ark
artworks.medium: brush and oil paint on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Partial Gift of Gilbert Butler, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring farm animals such as goats, cows, chickens, and ducks gathered together. Around the animals are a few people appearing to herd them towards a large structure on the right side of the painting. The man at the center has a long white beard and wears a red robe. The background shows blue sky with large white clouds, and the ground beneath the animals is brown. The brushstrokes are visible, especially those depicting the sky and structure.

artworks.title: Italian Park with a Tempietto
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John A. Pope, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a classical structure positioned centrally, surrounded by trees. The artwork is done with fine lines and textured brushstrokes in sepia tones. A person is seen pushing a wheelbarrow along a path towards the structure, with ruins nearby. There are stairs leading to the structure, creating a sense of balance and depth in the composition.
